meta.name: Fukrey Boyzzz
meta.description:
A troublemaking trio dreams big, plays hard and stirs up all sorts of classroom mischief in this animated spinoff of the popular Hindi film franchise.

Rated TV-Y · Returning Series · First aired 12 Oct 2019 · IN · Language: Hindi · 14 min

Not complete. On your server: S1 51/156 (missing E37, E53-156)

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Shiny Disco Shoe
videos.overview: The Fukrey have a dream about Shiny Disco shoes, which they want so badly that they participate in a marathon with the shoes as the first prize. To be sure of winning, they decide to take a shortcut and get into a hilarious mess.

videos.title: Chu Chu Control
videos.overview: Choocha drinks a lot of banta before going to class and then has to go to the toilet. In his desperation he answers Chuski's questions, making him intelligent, and he eventually represents the school in a quiz competition.

videos.title: Choocha Bana Principal
videos.overview: The school inspector is coming, and while waiting Murthy sir falls on his wheeled chair and goes out cold. The Fukrey Boyz see him in that state, and Choocha takes over as the principal, running the school as the inspector arrives.

videos.title: School Bana Cool
videos.overview: The Fukrey Boyz feel that the school is going to shut down because of funding. Fearing that they will be separated, they decide to rent out the premises of the school for functions.

videos.title: Happy Birthday Choocha
videos.overview: Honey wishes Choocha a happy birthday, alerting the entire school. But things become twisted when it's revealed kids with birthdays have to give extra tax to Bholi. Bholi ends up giving a party to everyone.

videos.title: Library Mein Bhoot
videos.overview: On a dare the Fukrey Boyz enter the 'haunted' school library, and after a few terrifying incidents they find there is no ghost there. So the Fukrey Boyz enjoy their time and eventually come out as bravehearts who dared to conquer the library.

videos.title: Goodluck Badluck
videos.overview: Choocha wears a good luck pendant that brings only good luck to him, but bad luck to all those around him. Eventually the others team up to get rid of Choocha's pendant

videos.title: Adarsh Balak
videos.overview: Choocha fears he is going to get rusticated, so he decides to behave like an Aadarsh Baalak the whole day. But acting like that for Choocha is an oxymoron.

videos.title: Sewa Ka Mewa
videos.overview: Pandit Ji has to go out of school for some urgent work during the school hours. He appoints the Fukrey Boyz to do his duties in school secretly without anyone knowing that he is missing, but the Fukrey Boyz mess it all up

videos.title: Khazana
videos.overview: Hunny's interpretation of Choocha's dream is that there's a treasure hidden in the school, and they have to dig it out. The treasure hunt begins, leading to the principal's room, and chaos and mayhem ensues.

videos.title: Lakhon Mein Do
videos.overview: A director has come to audition for an ad, and he chooses Choocha and Hunny as his Lakhon mein do stars. Choocha and Hunny become celebrities in school as the stars of tomorrow and start behaving pricey.

videos.title: Jasoos 000
videos.overview: The Fukrey Boyz see a poster of some spies wearing dark glasses and start spying on everyone in school. But they are so bad at it that they get all their conclusions wrong and create a huge mess in the school.

videos.title: Chooture Baba
videos.overview: Choocha get a crystal ball, and when he looks into it he can see the near future. As some of his predictions come true the school lines up to find out their future, and Choocha becomes Choocha Baba.

videos.title: Billu Canteen
videos.overview: Choocha and Honey are banned from Billu's shop. Panditiji and Honey convince Billu to open a branch in the school, but everything goes haywire.

videos.title: Christmas
videos.overview: In school, everyone has to write their wishes and decorate the Christmas tree, but the Fukrey Boyzz accidentally lose everyone's Christmas wishes. Now Choocha has to become Santa Claus and fulfill everyone's wishes.

videos.title: Silence
videos.overview: According to his interpretation of Choocha's dream, Hunny decides to remain silent for the day. But then Murthy selects Hunny to give a speech. He decides use sign language and Choocha will interpret.

videos.title: Balak of the Year
videos.overview: The Fukrey Boyzz are determined to win the Baalak of the Year competition that includes a Kabaddi competition, a display of talent and giving an impeccable speech.

videos.title: Chooche Ka Chooza
videos.overview: On the way to school the Fukrey Boyz find a golden egg. A chooza is born that takes Choocha to be its mother, and all hell breaks lose when the real mother hen comes to school looking for it.

videos.title: Choo-Bot
videos.overview: The Fukrey Boyz are going to be suspended if they don't come up with a working science project. So Hunny does a jugaad and dresses Choocha up in steel bartans to turn him into a robot called Choo-Bot.

videos.title: Last Wish
videos.overview: The Fukrey Boyz predict the world is going to end, and it spreads like wildfire in school. Everyone decides to fulfill their last wish, leading to things going bonkers.

videos.title: Choomos
videos.overview: A momos shop opens in direct competition with Billu's chole bhature and he starts to lose his customers. The Fukrey Boyz decide to do something to get the momos shop out.

videos.title: Money Plant
videos.overview: The Fukrey Boyz find out about 'money plant' and set out to grow money on trees. They plant a seed and nurture it like a baby, eventually finding money growing on its branches and are excited that 'money plants' do exist.

videos.title: Sports Day
videos.overview: The Fukrey Boyz are not selected for the regular sports day, so they create their own Fukrey Boyz sports day playing their own Desi games. Soon everyone else from the school joins the Fukrey sports day, making it a grand success.

videos.title: Teachers Day
videos.overview: To celebrate Teachers Day, the teachers become students and the Fukrey Boyz become teachers. The Fukrey Boyz start to mimic the teachers, while the teachers start to mimic the Fukrey Boyz, leading to a lot of fun in the school.

videos.title: Billu Bana Student
videos.overview: Billu comes to school to check the teaching standards and ends up becoming a student for the day. He wins the hearts of the other students, but creates a nuisance for the teachers and the Fukrey Boyz.

videos.title: Prankster
videos.overview: Choocha get a bag of pranks from his cousin in America, and the Fukrey Boyz set out doing pranks on everyone in the school. Soon a desperate search begins for the pranksters, and the Fukrey Boyz are going to get caught.

videos.title: Chooche Ki Hichki
videos.overview: Choocha starts to get hichki, which irritates everyone around him. Hunny finds out it is because Choocha is bored, so the school sets out to entertain Choocha before his hichki gets even worse.

videos.title: Cool Dude Choocha
videos.overview: Choocha has got conjunctivitis, and he wears dark glasses and looks like a dude. When others find out he has a conjunctivitis, everyone keeps away from him and Choocha is all alone, even Hunny and Laali stay away from him.

videos.title: Junglee Fukrey
videos.overview: The school goes on a trekking trip and the Fukrey Boyz get separated and lost from the rest of the school. They get into trouble with a group of monkeys and have to survive the jungle to find their way back to their group.

videos.title: Sher-O-Shayari
videos.overview: A Sher O shayari competition is being held in the school. The prize is a trip to the amusement park Magicstan. Hunny and Choocha decide to participate and leave no stone unturned to win, even if it means conversing with everyone in rhymes.

videos.title: Swagman
videos.overview: Choocha dreams that he's fighting aliens and Swag Man comes to their rescue. Hunny thinks they will meet him, and since the latest Swag Movie is in theaters, they must catch the show to see their favorite superhero.

videos.title: Fast Choocha Fast
videos.overview: There's water scarcity everywhere, and everyone is waiting for the rains. Hunny tells Choocha to fast for the rain, according to his interpretation of Choocha's dream. The school conspires against Choocha to stop him from eating.

videos.title: Ganja Choocha
videos.overview: Choocha starts losing his hair and everyone in school tries to help him stop the hair loss. When he goes complete bald, they try various wigs on him with funny consequences.

videos.title: Panditji Bane Teacher
videos.overview: When Chuski sir goes missing from the school, Panditji is appointed as a teacher for the day. He teaches well with practical examples, but the Fukrey do full masti during the class.

videos.title: Chuski VS Billu
videos.overview: Chuski Sir eats chole bhature and comments critically about them. This makes Billu angry, and he challenges Chuski sir to a competition about who among them is better in everything. The Fukrey Boyz end up training both contestants for the competition.

videos.title: Chuski ke Sapne
videos.overview: The Fukrey Boyz convince Chuski sir that he is a great actor and should forget about teaching to become an actor. They help him get the role of a 'star,' and in his excitement Chuski resigns from school.

videos.title: Bichde Bhai
videos.overview: Chuski sir gets irritated by the Fukrey Boyz continuously talking in class and decides to separate them for the entire day. Hunny and Choocha will do anything to be back with each other.

videos.title: Fukron Ki Diwali
videos.overview: It's a Diwali celebration in school and a contest is being held, whoever wins will get a Swagman goodies box! Also the Fukrey Boyz decide to show the school how to celebrate a cracker-free awesome Diwali.

videos.title: Class Monitor
videos.overview: As the class has become unruly, the teachers decide to hold an election for the class monitor. It's the Fukrey Boyz versus Bholi Ki Toli, and Choocha ends up having the deciding vote as on who will win.

videos.title: Sarvottam Choocha
videos.overview: Choocha eats the prasad ka halwa meant for Murthy sir's Guruji and becomes Sarvottam Guruji for the day. Murthy sir makes everyone treat Sarvottam Choochaji with respect and take his blessings.

videos.title: Sleepwalk
videos.overview: Murthy sir loses his glasses, and Hunny convinces him that Choocha's dream can help him find it. Choocha is forced asleep, but he begins to sleepwalk with everyone in school trying their best to not wake him up while keeping him out of danger.

videos.title: Bholi Ka Swag Man
videos.overview: Bholi snatches Choocha's Swagman action figure and it breaks into two pieces. Now Bholi wants Hunny and Laali to get a new action figure, while keeping Choocha as a hostage.

videos.title: Adarsh Republic Day
videos.overview: The school decides to celebrate Republic Day by showcasing a full-fledged parade of the students. Things go wrong, but come together in the end with the Fukrey winning a bravery award from Murthy sir.

videos.title: Chooche Ka Surr
videos.overview: There is a music competition and the Fukrey want sur in their voice, so they start to chase various animals thinking they will get their sur from various sureele animals.

videos.title: Chuski Muski Fuski
videos.overview: Chuski sir's nephews come to school, and the poor Fukrey are chosen to babysit them. The nephews are a handful, but Choocha forms a bond with them and encourages their mischief as they trouble Hunny, Laali and others in the school.

videos.title: School Mein Chor
videos.overview: It's a foggy and cold day and a thief enters school because it's the teachers salary day. But he comes across the Fukrey and gets into a big mess because of them.

videos.title: Bhai Ka Swag
videos.overview: Choocha sees Hunny solving many problem and winning people over with his swag. Choocha tries to copy Hunny's swag with disastrous results.

videos.title: Tu Mera Bhai Nahi Hai
videos.overview: Choocha isn't in the mood to do stuff for himself and wants Honey to help him out in everything. Hunny refuses Choocha, using the magic words, "Tu Mera Bhai Nahin Hai." And now Hunny has to do everything Choocha says, even if it leads to big trouble.

videos.title: Class Photo
videos.overview: The annual class photo is going to be taken, and a famous photographer is coming. The Fukrey mess it all up, but finally manage to save the day with a very unique class photo.

videos.title: Exam ki Tayiyari
videos.overview: It's exam time, and the Fukrey aren't ready to study. Everyone tries in their own way to make them study, but fail. Finally Chuski sir gets a brutal idea that helps the Fukrey pass the final exams.
